title: Kodiak, Yeti and Oil Creek recap: Poskin and Abma win at Big Bear
claims: Of 428 starters in the 2026 Kodiak 100M, 279 finished.
Cody Poskin's 16:46:21 was the third-fastest time on the Kodiak 100 course; Alex Proctor was second in 17:23:05 and Max Jolliffe third in 18:15:45.
Nichole Abma won the women's 100M in 20:43:40, the fourth-fastest women's time on the course; Madeline Wighardt was second in 22:05:50 and Charlotte Saunders third in 22:39:31.
Cole Campbell set a men's 50K course record of 3:20:42 and Anna Gibson set a women's 50K course record of 3:59:13.
